list.name: namespace
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "metrics", tag: "namespace", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "prometheus" and r.scrape_source == "cadvisor")

list.name: pod
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "metrics", tag: "pod", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "prometheus" and r.scrape_source == "cadvisor")

targets.query:
from(bucket: "metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "prometheus")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "container_cpu_usage_seconds_total")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.scrape_source == "cadvisor")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.namespace =~ /^${namespace:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.container != "" and r.cpu == "total")
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
